method: Terrain elevation angle is arcsin of the unit line of sight dotted with the local vertical. The horizon in each 0.5 degree azimuth bin is the maximum terrain elevation out to 250 km. Sun and Earth directions are SPICE LT+S vectors in the MOON_ME frame of DE421. A body center is clear when its elevation exceeds the terrain horizon at its azimuth. Center-clear is the reported window. Limb-clear is a separate column. Geometric visibility is not electrical power and is not a radio link.
boundaries: Geometric sunlight is line-of-sight past terrain. It is not electrical power.
Geometric Earth visibility is line-of-sight to Earth. It is not a radio link.
A mock integrity receipt is not a cryptographic signature and is not NASA approval.
